attBesluta.text: They are strong metal legs which worked well for my table I made with them, though I had some problems. The problem I had was the plate that is used to screw into the wood bowed on me when you follow the directions in order. I had a hard time with getting it to sit flat even with some areas being bent like in my picture which I eventually got bent back with clamps. After putting it together, I feel that it would of been better to do the directions in reverse order, to get the flat plate on first then to put the X legs on. I believe putting the legs all together before screwing them onto the wood caused the 4 bolts of the X legs connecting to the plates on the wood to bow, not making it sit flat against the wood. If I were to order these again in the future I would do the the plates to wood first screwed in, since it would also be easier to screw into the wood without the legs in the way of getting your tool straight. Other than those problems, they are strong legs which look like they can take a lot of weight.

I bought this to help get in and out of the pool and spa. I purchased an umbrella base to fit the diameter and it works better than I thought. With the base full of sand and water the handle is more than stable enough to allow just enough. “Assist” to help get out of either one. Let’s face it, pool entry handles are NOT aesthetically pleasing to look at! Now I can roll (umbrella base) out of the way when it’s not in use!
